show.name: Невский
show.summary: Since time immemorial, dark forces have been flattering themselves with the hope of conquering our beautiful planet. But every time they are opposed by heroes who stand up to defend their Motherland. Just such a hero lives in St. Petersburg. He is the most powerful and strong. He is so old that he himself has forgotten his name, so everyone simply calls him Nevsky. Once upon a time, it was he and several other heroes who stopped the countless armies of Pestilence, the conqueror of worlds. But the evil did not disappear, but hid in order to accumulate strength for a new invasion.

show.name: Айда!
show.summary: Grisha, a teenager from a privileged family, moves from Volgograd to Kazan and finds himself in the epicenter of a street gang war. He is a stranger in this world, but in order to survive, he has to learn its cruel rules. Zakharevich, the ideologue of the Tyap-Lyap gang, becomes an unexpected mentor for him. He is an intelligent, educated and ambitious manipulator who created a system for dragging teenagers into organized crime. The only one who is aware of the impending threat is the head of the criminal investigation department Nikonov. It will take time for him to understand that this is not just a criminal outburst, behind which there are non-ordinary figures, but the beginning of large-scale processes capable of destroying the country.

show.name: Искусство падения
show.summary: Dima, a young dancer, participates in a choreographic show and falls under the influence of a strict mentor, Phil. Together with his girlfriend, he becomes a participant in a psychological experiment that Phil puts on all the wards, testing them for their willingness to become real artists. But the dance show doesn't just change them. Renata is a tough and uncompromising producer who sees dancing exclusively as a business. However, her worldview is crumbling under the influence of the powerful energy of the young dancer Anton. As a result, dancing penetrates deeply into the lives of the characters, making them move in every sense of the word.

show.name: Красота
show.summary: The end of the 80s, a time of change and high hopes. Vera, the director of the House of Culture, launches the country's first beauty contest, despite the displeasure of officials. But against the background of the collapse of the country, it is under threat of closure — the country has no money for beauty. In an attempt to find a solution, Vera makes a deal with criminals, falling into a dangerous trap.

show.name: Against the Sky Supreme
show.summary: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

show.name: Cang Yuan Tu
show.summary: The story tells the story of Meng Chuan, the protagonist, who has made a vow to avenge his mother's death since he was a child and takes the Mirror Lake Daoist College as his starting point. With his resolute and fearless heart and decisive sword skills, he punishes the evil, destroys the demons, ascends to the top of the four Daoist Colleges, becomes famous in the Dongning Province, pays homage to the Yuanchu Mountain, and achieves a generation of gods and demons.(DeepL)

show.summary: Yun Si impersonates her slain twin sister to exact revenge on Prince Huo Linye, pairing with Prince Huo Shenzhi.

show.name: The Sound of Sugar Cubes
show.summary: An orphan, Han Yul didn't have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Han Yul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?

show.summary: Na Yeong, the vampire transfer student from Romania. Zero social skills, zero common sense, but also zero malice. Although Na Yeong has clear standards and logic, she cannot adapt to the human world and constantly goes astray and causes trouble at school, but upon meeting U Ju, she feels the emotion of a racing heart for the first time. A young vampire who falls in love with a human, and a fellow vampire who stirs her instincts; a sweet yet deadly romance of youths wavering between love and instinct.

show.summary: Notes of DNA Appraiser tells the story of Xu Ziqi, a rookie DNA paternity tester. Under the guidance of Mo Li, director of the Xin Nuo Paternity Testing Center, she teams up with the passionate young man Zhu Xinchen. Together, they fearlessly confront a stream of appraisal cases and uncover all kinds of life truths.

show.summary: During the Republic of China era, Wang Laowu, a veterinarian by trade, accidentally becomes the county magistrate of Fuhu County. Centering on ordinary people, the drama reveals how small characters forge a grand era in Republican China.

show.name: The Palace Gambit
show.summary: Two sisters are summoned to the imperial court. The elder is a woman of peerless beauty, the younger a quick-witted charmer. Seeking only a peaceful existence, they instead find themselves the targets of deadly schemes with no escape in sight. Forging an unstoppable alliance, they win the Emperor's favor within months. But at the peak of their glory, the elder sister, carrying the imperial heir, meets a tragic end. Overnight, their favor vanishes. Now, the younger sister, Lu Jiuning, buries her hatred and, from her lowly position as a palace maid, challenges the entire harem. She maneuvers among the consorts and stands firm before the Emperor, setting her meticulous plans for revenge. This battle is not for favor, but for blood!

Through shifting times, he moves from an ordinary worker to a man entangled in the underworld, navigating brotherhood, tangled love and hate, and moral choices. He ultimately finds self-growth and redemption amid the ice and black soil.

show.summary: From acrobatic football-volleyball in Malaysia to the World Championship in eating fries in Canada. Nicolay Ramm brings four of Norways bravest celebs out in the world. Here they will try to become the best in some of the worlds weridest sports.

show.name: My Chef in Crime
show.summary: Forensic scientist-turned-chef Chan becomes the prime suspect in his rival chef's mysterious death. He must clear his name, using his deep knowledge of food chemistry and forensic science, and teaming up with fearless investigative police officer Lieutenant Lalit whose past intertwines with his own. Together, they tackle intriguing cases through culinary experiments and create mouth-watering dishes.

body.name: Tallknuseren
body.summary: Can you survive in the Castle of Bluffs if you struggle with the multiplication tables? Well, perhaps. You could always try to bluff the others.

show.summary: In a fairytale castle, ten contestants compete against each other in a game that isn't about how smart you are, but about how smart people think you are.

body.name: Stilled Life
body.summary:
Resident wedding ruiner Mackenzie Clarke is paying the price for Glenn's absence. With Phil offside and a disastrous first impression made with new colleague Leo, she's not winning any popularity contests in Dolphin Cove.

So when an artist dies on stage in front of an audience during an avant-garde performance piece for the Dolphin Cove art fair, Mackenzie is dismayed to find that their main suspect, the victim's muse, has a surprising and complicated connection to her. Though Mack is well-versed in the art of mystery, even she can't figure out why the victim was clutching a red jelly baby.

show.name: Return to Paradise
show.summary: DI Mackenzie Clarke was meant to be back in the UK, living the life she's always wanted. Instead, she's still in Dolphin Cove. Lucky for Mack, her compulsion to solve impossible cases serves as a great distraction.

body.name: Built to Kill
body.summary:
Solitary Mackenzie Clarke reckons with the arrival of her uninhibited house guest. When a happy-go-lucky builder dies after falling from the roof of a construction site, she is immediately on the case. Mack knows a bodged-up job when she sees it. This was no accident, this was murder. The further Mack digs, the more she uncovers: a history of debt blackmail, illicit trysts and buried secrets.

How could anyone have pushed the victim when he was alone on the roof? And there's another mystery she has to solve - the secret Colin's keeping from her.

show.name: Return to Paradise
show.summary: DI Mackenzie Clarke was meant to be back in the UK, living the life she's always wanted. Instead, she's still in Dolphin Cove. Lucky for Mack, her compulsion to solve impossible cases serves as a great distraction.

body.name: The Final Shot
body.summary:
Lights, camera, murder. The anniversary screening of Dolphin Cove cult horror film Blood Wave goes off with a literal bang when one of its key creatives is killed during the iconic gunshot sequence. But how did the killer fire the gun in front of the packed house without the audience realising?

Theories abound, and not just about the murder, as Colin questions what significance the film holds for Mack and Glenn. And as the case builds to its climax, Mackenzie doesn't know whether it's harder to solve the crime or give Leo an answer when he asks her out on a date.

show.name: Return to Paradise
show.summary: DI Mackenzie Clarke was meant to be back in the UK, living the life she's always wanted. Instead, she's still in Dolphin Cove. Lucky for Mack, her compulsion to solve impossible cases serves as a great distraction.

body.name: Buried Past
body.summary:
1983. A young surfer leaves Dolphin Cove in pursuit of his dreams. Forty-three years later, his remains are found in the concrete by the ocean pool. But how is that possible when he left town before the concrete was even poured?

Mackenzie has her work cut out, with decades separating the investigation from the crime. The grim discovery stirs painful memories of Philomena's past, forcing her to confront history and heartache. Glenn's no stranger to that as he struggles to let go of his feelings for Mack, all while her connection with his replacement Leo blooms.

body.summary: A wildlife park worker is stabbed with their ornamental cassowary claw in a cassowary enclosure. The victim was the only one to access the cage, so how did the killer escape?

body.name: Vote One Murder
body.summary:
It's local council election day at Dolphin Cove Public School. Dirty tactics turn deadly when one of Reggie's fellow candidates is poisoned by passion fruit sponge cake. But how did the killer get the poisoned slice to their victim?

With suspects and motives in surplus, this is a case for Dolphin Cove's incumbent, brilliant detective Mackenzie Clarke, but it will be a long day at the polls for her. Suffering from self-doubt and heartbreak, she has lost her crime-solving mojo. Can Glenn get Mack back in the game, or will their campaign to find the murderer stall?

show.name: When I Meet the Moon
show.summary: The socially anxious Yun Li applies for a postgraduate program in Nanwu to prove her independence to her father. A day before the semester begins, she is invited to a local virtual reality (VR) center as a video creator. There, she reunites with Fu Shize, the genius and her high school crush. She gradually opens up, and, with the help of others, goes all out to court her dream man, winning him over with her warmth and radiance. However, amid the loving moments, their differing perspectives eventually lead to a breakup. When she goes abroad, his deeply suppressed trauma is brought to the forefront. To win her back, he gets back on his feet, leading his team to new heights in scientific research. When she returns to China, he pursues her relentlessly, and the two overcome their differences and rekindle their love.

With larger-than-life characters, thrilling twists, and exhilarating triumphs, the story follows a generation of young idealists who rise amid the storms of a troubled age, determined to shape the world around them and pursue their dreams.

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: The Silent Storm
show.summary: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

body.name: Square One
body.summary: Dwight regroups as Mitch and Spencer prep for a high stakes score. Bodhi expands a counterfeit scheme, and Tyson tests his rap ambitions.

show.name: Tulsa King
show.summary: Tulsa King follows New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi, just after he is released from prison after 25 years and unceremoniously exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a "crew" from a group of unlikely characters, to help him establish a new criminal empire in a place that, to him, might as well be another planet.

body.name: Eyes on the Inside
body.summary: When communication goes dark, Saga must get creative. Jonah investigates a cryptic symbol.

show.name: Nocturne
show.summary: Nocturne tells the story of Jonah Lynn, an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who, tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia, moves to a small town in Western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But, as the town and his family come under attack from the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter, Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the desperate search for Jurek's last missing victim forces Jonah to send his adopted daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer, up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?

previousepisode.name: For Such a Time as This

show.name: The Great Ruler
show.summary: In the vast world, planes converge and numerous races thrive. A gathering of extraordinary talents unfolds, where one after another, supreme beings from the lower planes come forth. In this boundless realm, they weave captivating legends that inspire admiration, pursuing the path to dominance.

body.name: We Don't Talk Anymore
body.summary: Harry's covert strike pours petrol on the escalating war. Eddie slides further off the rails under Maeve's manipulations. Bella and Seraphina plot a long game as Conrad starts to crack, and a new adversary enters the frame.

show.name: MobLand
show.summary:
With the most powerful clients in Europe, MobLand will see family fortunes and reputations at risk, odd alliances unfold, and betrayal around every corner; and while the family might be London's most elite fixers today, the nature of their business means there is no guarantee what's in store tomorrow.

MobLand follows two generations of gangsters, the businesses they run, the complex relationships they weave and the man they call upon to fix their problem.

show.name: Amanpour
show.summary: Amanpour is CNN International's flagship global affairs interview program hosted by Chief International Correspondent Christiane Amanpour.

show.name: LOL: Last One Laughing Philippines
show.summary: "LOL" or "Last One Laughing" is a reality show where ten comedians battle it out to make each other laugh. With no smiles allowed, they unleash their best jokes and antics, aiming to make each other crack up for six hours. It's a hilarious battle of wit and self-control, where the last one laughing wins ONE MILLION PESOS!

body.summary: Navigating his mid-life crisis, Dexter finds no comfort as the Five Borough Killer captivates New York City. Meanwhile, his son Harrison starts at NYPD Homicide.

show.name: Dexter: Resurrection
show.summary: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

show.name: The Assassin
show.summary:
Secluded on a remote Greek island, retired assassin Julie has a somewhat thorny reunion with her estranged son, Edward, visiting from England. Armed with questions around new information on his paternity, Edward battles to find the right time to speak to his frustratingly distant mother. But, when the moment finally presents itself, things take a deadly turn as Julie's dangerous past catches up with her and they are forced to flee the island and go on the run together.

Edward's quest for truth clashes with Julie's secrecy whilst they are forced to work together in a fight for survival, testing their dysfunctional relationship to its limits. Amid uncovering a dark conspiracy they believe to be their only threat, a greater danger emerges that will destroy their relationship entirely. In a race against time, Julie fights to save Edward and salvage their relationship as past and present collide in a showdown across the globe…

Secluded on a remote Greek island, retired assassin Julie has a somewhat thorny reunion with her estranged son, Edward, visiting from England. Armed with questions around new information on his paternity, Edward battles to find the right time to speak to his frustratingly distant mother. But, when the moment finally presents itself, things take a deadly turn as Julie's dangerous past catches up with her and they are forced to flee the island and go on the run together.

Edward's quest for truth clashes with Julie's secrecy whilst they are forced to work together in a fight for survival, testing their dysfunctional relationship to its limits. Amid uncovering a dark conspiracy they believe to be their only threat, a greater danger emerges that will destroy their relationship entirely. In a race against time, Julie fights to save Edward and salvage their relationship as past and present collide in a showdown across the globe…

show.name: The Traitors Italia
show.summary: A group of celebrities roam a spectacular mansion challenging each other in a psychological game that involves constant teamwork to complete missions and accumulate a cash prize. But hidden among the contestants are traitors who will try to deceive and manipulate the rest of the group to grab the ultimate prize for themselves alone, while the others, unaware of who the traitors are, work as a team with the aim of eliminating them from the game. The stakes will be high and will test everyone's ability to juggle a dense web of alliances and betrayals. If at least one traitor makes it to the end of the game he will keep the entire prize money for himself, but if all the traitors are unmasked, the other participants still in the game can divide the prize equally.

show.name: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
show.summary: Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world's best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.

show.name: Furia
show.summary: A contemporary portrait around five women ready to do anything in the face of extreme situations such as extortion, oppression, deceit, exclusion or manipulation in a single shared universe articulated around five conflicts that will develop like a butterfly effect – one as a consequence of the other – and so on to shared catharsis.

show.name: American Pulse
show.summary: American Pulse is an hour showcasing reporting from the vast network of CNN affiliates across the country.

show.name: The Football Interview
show.summary: The biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation's favourite sport.

show.name: Star Trek: Scouts
show.summary: Star Trek: Scouts follows three 8-year-old friends, JR, Sprocket and Roo, as they train to become future Starfleet Explorers by going on epic, out-of-this-world missions that push them to "discover, grow and boldly go!"

previousepisode.name: The Scouts Solve a Stinky Gas Problem!

show.name: The Great Long March
show.summary: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.

body.summary: A crash course at the Culinary Institute of America opens the door for Nora to attempt a family recipe.

show.name: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook
show.summary:
Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook Nora embarks on a deeply personal cross-country journey as she explores contemporary Asian American cuisine, starting with her family's remarkable legacy.

Nora's family ran Lum's, the iconic Cantonese restaurant in Flushing, New York, and the very first in a now thriving Chinatown. But despite growing up in the family business, she can't cook. At all. She could ruin an instant ramen.

body.name: Texas Barbecue
body.summary: Jimmy O. Yang joins Nora as they hit the road in Texas to learn about the state's most iconic food.

show.name: 4 Blocks Zero
show.summary: The prequel to the award-winning gangster drama ‘4 Blocks' tells the story of the Hamadys in 1990s Berlin: having fled Lebanon and only accepted as tolerated refugees in Germany, they struggle to gain a foothold in their new home. Who are they, how did the family become the most influential clan in the city, and how did Ali eventually become Toni?

show.name: Oops! Mysterious Sounds
show.summary: A second-hand pair of earphones connects two rivals to the world of the dead. When their idol friend dies under mysterious circumstances, what starts as enemies forced to "fake date" turns into an undeniable bond as they become reluctant partners in a murder investigation. Before the killer... silences them as the next victims. The deeper they dig, the closer they get to death-and to each other. Until they can no longer tell which one is louder: the "voice of the dead" or the "sound of their racing hearts".

show.name: TFI Unplugged
show.summary: With the biggest bands performing exclusive intimate sets and unfiltered conversations with A-list celebrity guests, TFI Unplugged is the place where anything can happen. Chris Evans reinvents your favourite television institution for 2026.

previousepisode.name: Celebrity Traitors Special with Ed Gamble, Christian Horner & Fred Sirieix

show.name: The Producer
show.summary: When an aspiring music producer teams up with a veteran mogul, the unlikely duo sets out to conquer the Mandopop scene.

show.name: The Necromancer! I Am A Disaster
The Necromancer! I Am A Disaster
show.summary: The game has crossed into reality, and the old rules no longer apply. Humanity enters an age where anyone can awaken a class, but the opportunity draws unwanted attention: demons from the abyss and the dragonkin both want this new world, and neither is willing to share it. Lin Moyu wakes up in this world with the one class no one else has: Necromancer. His talent is unmatched, his ability system unlike anything else in play, and he grows stronger with every fight, building an army out of the dead until he no longer needs anyone else at his side. As the Shenxia Empire's last line of defense against the abyssal invasion, he becomes the one man capable of breaking the deadlock between humans, demons, and dragons, and the one who ends up standing above all three.

show.name: Paolo
show.summary: Paolo's ordinary working-class existence is upended when he encounters the ambitious, and magnetic local politician Téophane, an old school mate. What begins as admiration and a desire to help Téophane's campaign, soon spirals into an all-consuming obsession, leading to a deadly ride in this intense psychological Ripley-style thriller.

show.name: Teeny Mutant Ninja Turtles
show.summary: Everyone's favorite ninja turtles, Leo, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey, are back! Set in their childhood years, this original series explores the early days of the iconic ninja turtles on their first adventures as ninjas-in-training. They'll even be joined by their friend April O'Neil, and encounter foes like Bebop, Rocksteady, and Karai.

show.name: Zmora
show.summary: A disgraced journalist returns to her hometown and sets out to investigate the unsolved disappearance of a childhood friend.

show.name: Palacio
show.summary: On November 6, 1985, an M-19 guerrilla commando forcibly entered the Palace of Justice and took more than 300 people hostage, including Supreme Court justices. On November 7, the Colombian Army retook the Palace. Inspired by real and publicly known events, the series recounts what happened during the siege and retaking of the Palace of Justice, which resulted in the deaths and disappearances of at least 94 people, including justices, guerrilla members, civilians and members of the military. It also follows the victims' families in their pursuit of justice for more than 20 years.

A business venture brings them together as partners, and Zhao Shengge unexpectedly begins making the first moves, gradually closing the distance Chen Wan has so carefully maintained. Will a secret love that never dared for hope finally bloom?

The plan was simple: defeat the boss as a party of four, log out, and finish the test play safely — or at least, that's how it was supposed to go.

But when Wei Yan Zi accidentally discovers a fan community dedicated to shipping the two of them, he becomes hopelessly obsessed. Little does he know that the seemingly aloof Gu Yi Liang has already fallen for him. Believing Wei Yan Zi hates him, Gu can only watch over him from afar.

show.summary: I Kill The Bear is a comedy about a family of bear wranglers for film sets, and why – after 100 years – they've decided to make this film their last.

show.summary: Yaga follows Rapp, a private investigator who arrives in a small coastal town to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery, Henry Park. Rapp finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, Carson, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, Katherine, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

show.name: Mystery Science Theater 3000
show.summary:
Mystery Science Theater 3000 started as a locally produced television show for KTMA in Minnesota but soon grew in popularity. It moved to Comedy Central (originally the Comedy Channel), then to Syfy. After an eighteen-year hiatus, the crew of the Satellite of Love returned in 2017, airing on Netflix for two seasons. In 2021, the production started its own streaming service, The Gizmoplex, where the riffing of cheesy movies continues. Rifftrax revitalised the series once again in 2026 with four more episodes of the series. 

Over the years, there have been several "test subjects": Joel Robinson, Mike Nelson, Jonah Heston, and Emily Connor along with their robot friends Tom Servo, Crow T Robot, and Gypsy (now GPC) all subjected to bad movies thanks to a host of mad scientists including Doctor Clayton Forrester, his mother Pearl, and most recently Kinga Forrester.
